title: A shared custom holds changing responses
meaning: Combining different ways of participating for shared meaning is emotionally accompanied by the experience of events taking different turns.
text: A familiar meaning can remain through different participation. Temperance in the physical position of this Energy Field appears through shared actions where you combine different needs and ways of taking part. The Hierophant in energy connects motivation with a recognised value, custom or shared promise. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions adds an experience of changing circumstances. The overall tone can join continuity with movement: you practically accommodate differences for an important occasion, while the emotional response changes as the shared situation itself unfolds.

For example, you keep the custom of gathering on a significant date, but one person contributes more beforehand while the other does more on the day. Different actions come together around shared meaning. An unexpected guest cancellation disappoints, another suggestion encourages, and a changed time brings frustration again. **Our custom remains meaningful, although its unfolding course changes our feelings.** Alternation does not establish that combining contributions was mistaken or that the recognised value has disappeared.

A difficulty arises if tradition requires equal enjoyment of every turn. Changing feelings then seem to threaten shared meaning, and differences must be hidden. Or changeability justifies a burden that no longer suits one person. The Wheel promises no even response, and the Hierophant makes no single format compulsory. Temperance in action allows the relationship between contributions to be revised when the gathering’s actual course changes conditions for both people. Meaning need not depend on preserving an inconvenient proportion.
